beginner.summary: For developers who know Ruby basics such as classes, blocks and hashes and are new to Rails. Covers installing Rails 8, the directory layout and Zeitwerk, the request lifecycle, routing, controllers with params.expect, ERB views, migrations, Active Record queries, validations, associations, forms, Turbo Drive and Frames, the built-in authentication generator, credentials, Minitest, debugging, linting with RuboCop and Brakeman, and a bookmarks application capstone.
prerequisites: Writes small Ruby programs using classes, modules, blocks and hashes
Knows basic HTML and HTTP concepts such as methods, status codes and forms
Has a laptop with a terminal, Git and rights to install Ruby, SQLite and an editor such as Visual Studio Code
outcomes: Generate, run and navigate a Rails 8 application and explain its request lifecycle
Model data with migrations, validations and associations and query it with Active Record
Build forms, views and Turbo-enhanced pages with safe parameter handling and sign-in
Test, lint and scan a small application with Minitest, RuboCop and Brakeman

advanced.summary: For senior developers and technical leads running Rails in production. Covers multiple databases, multi-tenancy, PostgreSQL features, zero-downtime migrations, locking and idempotency, Puma tuning, profiling, job reliability, Action Cable at scale, Kamal deployment, hardened Docker images, security hardening, encryption, structured logging, OpenTelemetry, framework internals, upgrades, modular monoliths and a multi-tenant SaaS capstone.
prerequisites: Has shipped and maintained a Rails application with background jobs and a test suite
Understands SQL execution plans, indexes and transactions
Has used Docker and a Linux server over SSH
outcomes: Design data access across replicas, tenants and PostgreSQL features without losing consistency
Operate Rails with tuned Puma, reliable jobs, structured logs and traces
Deploy and roll back with Kamal on hardened containers and security controls
Upgrade Rails and enforce module boundaries in a large codebase
